description: Boot-test the clang-built kernel in nono, diagnose failures (fix LLVM backend bugs on a new branch off clang-netbsd-target with lit tests), verify the GCC build still works, and write the README. Depends on FEAT-002.
steps: Boot environment: /usr/local/bin/nono 1.8.2 exists. Create a headless config in the task dir (copy of /home/mk2s/Documents/netbsd-src/nono.cfg with hostnet-driver=none, hostsound-driver=none, and hostcom-driver=stdio or tcp port 20023; check 'nono --help' / --show-config for the real key names and whether a headless/no-GUI mode exists, e.g. xvfb-run or a -V option). Do NOT modify nono.cfg in netbsd-src. Check how the luna88k boot ROM loads a kernel: nono -X <file> loads host a.out/ELF directly (try nono -X GENERIC_CLANG/netbsd); otherwise a disk image with boot loader is needed (look in ~/luna88k-img and ~/Documents for a bootable image or sd image; the stand/boot loader must be built by the GCC tools which is out of scope).

First boot the GCC reference ELF the same way and capture serial console output to clang-netbsd-kernel/boot-gcc.log (use timeout, e.g. timeout 60 nono ... > log 2>&1, or the tcp serial port with nc). Then boot the clang kernel and capture boot-clang.log. Success = banner plus autoconf output and then 'no root device'/panic equal to GCC's. Compare the logs with diff.

If the clang kernel misbehaves: use nono's debugger (debugger-driver=tcp, see nono docs/--help) or console traces to locate the first divergence; compare disassembly (llvm-objdump -d vs m88k--netbsdelf3-objdump -d) of the failing function between the two kernels; classify root cause (LLVM codegen, assembler, source/ABI). For an LLVM backend root cause: create branch off clang-netbsd-target in /home/mk2s/Documents/llvm-m88k (git switch -c clang-netbsd-kernel-fixes clang-netbsd-target or continue on clang-netbsd-kernel as already created), add fix plus lit test under llvm/test/CodeGen/M88k, run build/bin/llvm-lit on llvm/test/CodeGen/M88k and MC/M88k, rebuild clang/lld, rebuild kernel, re-test boot. Commit each fix separately.

If nono cannot run in this environment (no display, no tap, missing ROM), say so clearly, mark boot UNVERIFIED, and write exact user steps (file placement, boot command, nono command line) in the README. Never claim a boot without a captured log.

GCC regression: on branch clang-luna88k-kernel, rebuild the original GENERIC kernel with original tools in a scratch copy of the compile dir (do not overwrite reference netbsd): nbmake-luna88k in the copy with PATH/tools as configured; confirm it builds (or at minimum that every touched file compiles with m88k--netbsdelf3-gcc). Compare resulting size output with the reference.

Write /home/mk2s/Documents/llvm-m88k/.agents/tasks/clang-netbsd-kernel/README.md: branches and commit hashes (NetBSD clang-luna88k-kernel, LLVM clang-netbsd-kernel), decisions (-std, -Wno-* list and why, where config lives), exact reproduction commands from clean (config, wrapper, nbmake with overrides, link, assym diff, bulk.sh, nono boot), results table for done criteria 1-7 with evidence file paths, remaining risks. Commit NetBSD changes; commit LLVM changes on the LLVM branch; do not commit other untracked .agents files and do not push.
acceptance_criteria: boot-gcc.log and boot-clang.log exist OR README states explicitly that boot could not run, why, and gives user steps
Any LLVM fix has a lit test and passes llvm-lit for M88k
GCC build still builds, evidence logged
README.md has exact commands and honest results for all 7 done criteria
All changes committed locally on clang-luna88k-kernel and clang-netbsd-kernel; nothing pushed
verification: build/bin/llvm-lit -v llvm/test/CodeGen/M88k llvm/test/MC/M88k passes (if LLVM changed)
git log on both branches shows commits; git status in netbsd-src shows only the pre-existing untracked files
findings: BOOT VERIFIED: clang GENERIC kernel boots in nono 1.8.2 to 'root device:' like GCC (boot-gcc.log, boot-clang.log, boot.diff; only diffs: symtab addr/entries, version string, avail memory 61536 vs 61588 KB, random le0 MAC). Boot command: sh /home/mk2s/Documents/llvm-m88k/.agents/tasks/clang-netbsd-kernel/boot-nono.sh <elf> <log> [secs] (nono -c nono-headless.cfg -V hostcom-driver=stdio -X <elf> under script(1) + timeout -s KILL; dipsw1=10111111 serial console; TCP console drops output, not used). Always check pgrep -a nono afterwards. LLVM fixes on clang-netbsd-kernel: c3b64cf74ad7 M88kDelaySlotFiller records implicit operands (CARRY) -> fixed uvm_map_findspace miscompile/panic 'uvm_km_suballoc'; test CodeGen/M88k/delay-slot-filler.mir. a484b97d8537 GlobalISel load_and_mask no load narrowing on big-endian (and(load i32),255 became ld.bu of MSB) -> fixed callout_hardclock and hang after scsibus wait; test CodeGen/M88k/load-and-mask-be.ll. llvm-lit CodeGen/M88k+MC/M88k: 72/72 pass. clang/llc/lld rebuilt. NetBSD fix on clang-luna88k-kernel: be931f7e0a40 lunafb.c volatile plane probe (clang showed 8bpp). Final OK count: bulk.sh 284 OK / 0 FAIL, no LLVM ERROR. llvm-nm -u = 0, assym.h equal (whitespace-normalised sort). -Wno-* list unchanged from FEAT-001/002 (19 flags in clang-wrapper.sh). Build command: sh .../clang-netbsd-kernel/build.sh netbsd; wrapper /home/mk2s/Documents/llvm-m88k/.agents/tasks/clang-netbsd-kernel/clang-wrapper.sh. GCC regression: fresh nbconfig into /tmp/nb/GENERIC_GCC, nbmake assym.h then -j8 netbsd with original tools exit 0; size text 1422972 vs ref 1423148, data/bss equal; boots to root device (boot-gcc-regress.log). Reference GENERIC/netbsd untouched (1735468 bytes, 2026-09-28 10:00:04.834972645). README.md written. Risks: only boot-to-root-prompt tested; GCC vs clang stack-arg ABI differs (+32 home area, struct-by-value regs) so mixing objects/hand asm with stack args is unsafe; ddb trace GCC-specific.
